title: Do you need a biometric attendance machine?
description: How fingerprint and face attendance machines help small offices and shops in Dubai, and what to ask before buying one.
body: Paper sign-in sheets are easy to forget and easy to fill in for a colleague. A biometric attendance machine records each person's time automatically.
Fingerprint readers are affordable and common. Face recognition is touch-free and works well where staff wear gloves or have worn fingerprints.
Attendance only, or door access too?
Some machines also open a door. If you want to control who enters, choose a model that supports a lock and plan the door hardware at the same time.
How will you get the reports?
Ask how reports are downloaded: by USB, network or cloud software. We set this up and show you how it works.
